# awscc_ec2_ipam_external_resource_verification_token (Resource)

A verification token is an AWS-generated random value that you can use to prove ownership of an external resource. For example, you can use a verification token to validate that you control a public IP address range when you bring an IP address range to AWS (BYOIP).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ipam_id` (String) The ID of the IPAM that will create the token.

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes Set) The tags for the token. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `ipam_arn` (String) The ARN of the IPAM that created the token.
- `ipam_external_resource_verification_token_arn` (String) The ARN of the IPAM external resource verification token.
- `ipam_external_resource_verification_token_id` (String) The ID of the token.
- `ipam_region` (String) The Region of the IPAM that created the token.
- `not_after` (String) The token expiration.
- `state` (String) The token state.
- `status` (String) The token status.
- `token_name` (String) The token name.
- `token_value` (String) The token value.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The tag key.
- `value` (String) The tag value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ec2_ipam_external_resource_verification_token.example
  identity = {
    ipam_external_resource_verification_token_arn = "ipam_external_resource_verification_token_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `ipam_external_resource_verification_token_arn` (String) The ARN of the IPAM external resource verification token

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ec2_ipam_external_resource_verification_token.example
  id = "ipam_external_resource_verification_token_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_ec2_ipam_external_resource_verification_token.example "ipam_external_resource_verification_token_arn"
```
